title: 26-§. Keltirish formulalari

questions.q: Keltirish formulalarida qaysi burchaklarda funksiyaning nomi kofunksiyasiga (sin ↔ cos, tg ↔ ctg) o'zgaradi?
questions.explain: Vertikal o'q (90° va 270°) nuqtalarida funksiya nomi o'zgaradi.

questions.q: sin(π/2 + α) ifoda nimaga teng?
questions.explain: π/2 da sin → cos ga almashadi; o'tkir α uchun π/2+α II chorakda va sin > 0.

questions.q: cos(π/2 + α) ifoda nimaga teng?
questions.explain: II chorakda boshlang'ich cos manfiy, shuning uchun −sin α.

questions.q: sin(180° − α) = sin α formulasi barcha α lar uchun o'rinli.
questions.explain: 180° da nomi saqlanadi, II chorakda sinus musbat.

questions.q: cos(180° − α) = cos α ga teng.
questions.explain: II chorakda kosinus manfiy bo'lgani uchun cos(180° − α) = −cos α.

questions.q: sin(π/2 − α) ifodani keltirish formulasi bilan soddalashtiring.
